title: How much is a surprise worth?
summary: A surprise is worth the number of fair yes/no questions it saves you: the rarer the news, the more questions it is worth, and the average over all the news a source can send is its entropy. We build the idea from a café where tickets pass through a hatch, check it in a four-word weather village with a notebook to practise on, say where it fails, and ask whose model sets the price of a surprise.
